title: IMAGIC-500: IMputation benchmark on A Generative Imaginary Country (500k samples)
reasoning: The paper benchmarks imputation methods on a socioeconomic dataset. While 'religion' is one of the 19 demographic features in the dataset, the study evaluates general data reconstruction accuracy (RMSE and F1 score) and impact on downstream predictive tasks like educational attainment, rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious, moral, or ethical constructs.
